eas_text: A civil authority has issued A HAZARDOUS MATERIALS WARNING for the following counties or areas: Mahaska, IA; at 6:58 PM on AUG 25, 2021 Effective until 8:58 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Due to a chemical spill in Eddyville, we are asking all residents to shelter in place.  Close up windows and HVAC and stay in your home.
